question:
Let \(\theta_1,\theta_2,\ldots,\theta_{10}\) be any values in the closed interval \([0,\pi]\). Show that
\[
F=(1+\sin^2\theta_1)(1+\cos^2\theta_1)(1+\sin^2\theta_2)(1+\cos^2\theta_2)\cdots(1+\sin^2\theta_{10})(1+\cos^2\theta_{10})\le \left(\frac94\right)^{10}.
\]
What is the maximum value attainable by \(F\) and at what values of \(\theta_1,\theta_2,\ldots,\theta_{10}\) is the maximum value attained?

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
